_comment: Example scenario for `python3 run_sim.py explore`. Format: docs/scenario-format.md. Every key that starts with an underscore is a comment and is ignored.
title: Lost acknowledgement; receipt delayed 12 ticks; status lags 8 ticks and lists pending work; a failed key is burned
_status_lag: Status reads at tick t see provider records with record_time <= t - status_lag. Use "never" if status never shows anything before the final cutoff.

options._comment: Named options (arr/options.py). Omitted options keep the frozen protocol defaults.
options._status_lists_pending: Does your status API list attempts it has accepted but not finished? true adds pending_attempts to not_found replies.
options._abort_record: Contract 2 only: after a failed (aborted) execution, is the idempotency key released (release) or does a later request with that key get the stored failure (replay_failure)?
options._horizon: How long (ticks after the operation starts) your agent waits before it must answer.

operations._comment: One logical operation: a stable op_key and an immutable payload. start = tick of the first dispatch.

1._comment: Attempt 1 overrides the nominal rule (arrive +1, commit 1 tick after arrival, ok 1 tick after commit, committed receipt 2 ticks after emission). Attempts not listed are nominal unless options.retry_fault is copy_first.
1._response: null = the response is lost; {"kind": "error", "after": 1} would send a 5xx-style error instead of ok.
1._webhooks: Delivery offsets after each emission: [] = lost, [12, 13] = delivered twice. Add "processing" or "deferred" (with deferred_after) to emit progress events.
